title: Laodamas
summary: Raleigh names Laodamas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Laodamas, sonne of Eteocles, King of the Thebanes when the Epigoni came (Creon his Tutor). No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. VIII, sig. 273a–273b
